newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Finland's Wartsila, U.S. Hanover form j/v.
newsitem.headline: Finland's Wartsila, U.S. Hanover form j/v.

text.p: Finland's Wartsila Diesel, a unit of Metra Oy, said it and Houston-based Hanover Company agreed to form a jointly-owned company named Wartsila Compression Systems GmbH based in Berlin. Wartsila Diesel will hold 67 percent of the new company's shares and Hanover 33 percent, Wartsila said.

Wartsila Diesel was described as a world leader in the design and manufacture of medium speed diesel and gas engines while Hanover Co was the world's largest in compression rental, fabrication, maintenance and operations.

"(The partnership) will allow Hanover the opportunity not only to extend its leadership position in the North and South American compression markets but, as partners, to become the worldwide leaders in the compression business," Hanover's chief executive, Michael McGhan, said in a statement.

Chairman of Wartsila Compression Systems, Johan Stoor, said the partnership provided an opportunity to further develop its business towards the gas compression applications based on its new gas engine portfolio.
"The Hanover Co will have an exclusive distributorship of Wartsila engines for the applications in North and South AMercia," Stoor said in a statement.
